name: wallet_multichain_balances
description: Get balances across multiple supported EVM chains and calculate the wallet's combined total USD value. Provide an addresses map keyed by chain_id; if chain_ids is omitted, all supported balance chains are queried.

addresses.description: Map of chain IDs to wallet addresses, for example {"ethereum":"0x...","base":"0x..."}.

chain_ids.description: Optional chain IDs to limit the aggregation scope.
